Limitations: This build uses Tree-sitter only. It does not use Roslyn or any compiler semantic model.

Declaration candidates are based on C# grammar name fields. They are not proven-safe rename targets and may include public contracts, reflection-sensitive names, serialization members, XAML-bound members, or names used externally.
Identifier occurrences are listed syntactically only. Tree-sitter does not bind references to declarations, resolve overloads, resolve types, or identify the assembly that owns a referenced symbol.
Names inside strings, comments, XAML, RESX, JSON, reflection expressions, generated source, and runtime data may affect renaming but are not covered by the C# identifier inventory.
This experimental build currently inventories C# only. Visual Basic files are reported as unsupported.
No source files are modified. Rename authorization is always disabled.
